Then combined with an example of poor parallel current sharing of a low dropout voltage linear regulator, the problem and mechanism are analyzed, the main factors affecting parallel current sharing are studied, and an optimization method is proposed. The current mirror circuit and layout of the device are redesigned by optimizing the internal feedback proportional coefficient of the device. The improved product is verified and tested by simulation. The results meet the design expectations and the uneven current sharing is effectively solved. The improved method is feasible and practical.

articleTitle: X-ray pulsar signal period estimation based on improved Lomb-Scargle algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: In view of the measurement error of the photon arrival time of the X-ray pulsar and the amplitude deviation caused by the unnormalized processing in the Lomb-Scargle periodogram method, the paper introduces an error weight factor and adds a constant term in the least squares construction The method improves the Lomb-Scargle periodogram method. When using the improved Lomb-Scargle method to estimate the photon arrival time period, the amount of data processed is large and the power calculation formula contains more trigonometric functions, which will bring a huge amount of calculation. In order to improve the calculation speed, when using the improved Lomb-Scargle algorithm for spectrum estimation, FFT transform is used to speed up the calculation process. In order to improve the accuracy of period estimation, a method based on frequency multi-layer subdivision is proposed, which makes it possible to solve the high-precision pulsar rotation period under short-term observation conditions. Experiments with the B0531+21 pulsar as the observation object show that the method proposed in this article has higher estimation accuracy and faster calculation speed than traditional pulsar period estimation methods.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Intelligent Virtual Entrepreneurship System under .NET Platform and Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: With the advancement of the national innovation strategy of mass entrepreneurship and innovation, college students' innovation and entrepreneurship have also developed rapidly. In order to further save project human management resources, improve the management level of college students' innovation and entrepreneurship, and enhance their ability to innovate and entrepreneurship This article summarizes the student simulation entrepreneurship platform system, that is, students first through entrepreneurship education, cultivate entrepreneurial awareness, learn basic company management knowledge, cultivate team management capabilities, and then use the community mutual assistance platform to obtain human resources, form a team, and then participate in the competition The training platform carries out virtual and physical entrepreneurial practice training. On this basis, a team with a mature entrepreneurial plan can be formed, which can apply for incubation and enter the entrepreneurial incubation platform. The platform system is systematic and systematic in operation, which can be used as a reference for relevant peers.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Artificial Intelligence in Computer Network Technology in Big Data Era
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: The 21st century is an information age, and it is also a data age. The importance of data information resources is highlighted under the background of big data age. While the development of computer and its derivative technology promotes the growth of computer science, it also makes the artificial intelligence technology gradually mature. A lot of problems need to be considered, mainly including the efficiency, real-time. However, the computer network structure is becoming more and more complex, resulting in the low efficiency of computer network communication. With the development of artificial intelligence technology, it provides an effective solution to this problem. Artificial intelligence algorithm can optimize the whole network according to the scale of the network and the deployment of equipment, so as to improve the communication quality and efficiency of computer network.

articleTitle: Application of BERT Based on Entity-Aware in HICH Emergency Clinical Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Emergency clinical diagnosis is an important part of medical diagnosis. The number of emergency doctors is small, and the time cost is high. While emergency clinical diagnosis is particularly important in HICH. Therefore, this paper proposes an application of BERT based on Entity-Aware in HICH emergency clinical diagnosis for improving the performance of automating HICH medical diagnosis. In our model, we establish an interpretability framework with designed multiple structures of electronic medical records (EMRs). Furthermore, in order to implement EMRs reasoning and ensure the accuracy of diagnostic results, weighted structure and entity-aware network are explored for entity-relationship feature re-processing. Finally, experimental results indicate that our proposed model outperforms other compared methods.

articleTitle: Design and comparison of two kinds of silicon-on-insulator wavelength demultiplexers based on multimode interference
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: In this paper two kinds of wavelength demultiplexers with paired and beveled structures that work at 1.3µm /1. 55µm were presented. The various states of the wavelength demultiplexers were simulated and analyzed respectively using the finite difference beam propagation method (FD-BPM), the structure parameters of the wavelength demultiplexers were also designed and optimized. At last, the tolerance, excellence and disadvantage of the wavelength demultiplexers were analyzed and compared.

articleTitle: Feature Selection Criteria for Clustering Based on Support Vectors
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Existing feature selection for clustering task usually relies on some statistical methods or some clustering quality evaluation, both of which need an assumption of data distribution. That heavily affects the generalization ability of feature selection in applications. This paper proposes feature selection criteria derived from support vector technique to address this problem. Firstly the least power support vector clustering (LPSVC) is presented. Based on products of LPSVC, an institutive criterion and a derivative criterion are proposed. These two LPSVC-based criteria keep data distribution shape as much as possible after features are removed. And they are equipped with selection algorithm to discard unimportant features. Empirical evidence suggests the proposed criteria are of fine quality.

articleTitle: Research on Mechanics System in Civil Engineering through Computer Big Data Technology and Visual Simulation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Metro section tunnels are constructed by undercutting method. Different section excavation methods and excavation sequences will cause different section deformation, vault subsidence and ground surface settlement. Therefore, how to excavate sections reasonably and what support methods are adopted, And the reinforcement measures of the surrounding rock masses will become the key factors for controlling surface settlement. Aiming at the characteristics of tight construction period, district filling of different materials, and high material transportation intensity in subway section tunnel construction, the functions and design principles of the subway section tunnel construction scheduling and simulation adopted, system are analyzed, and the construction information management and The design idea of optimizing the combination of deployment, information management and visualization technology, systematically discussed the main content and implementation methods of each function, and designed and developed practical software for related projects. Finally, the paper uses actual cases to carry out finite element numerical simulation calculations. A more reasonable excavation and support method is obtained through comparison and selection, which can be used as a reference for similar projects.

articleTitle: Deformation monitoring of highway goaf based on three-dimensional laser scanning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: With the rapid development of transportation expressway, different traffic lines must pass through different geological areas. For expressways, when they pass through areas with abundant mineral resources, they may face the instability and destruction of roadbed and pavement of expressways in mining areas caused by mining and goaf subsidence. Because 3D laser scanning technology has the characteristics of non-contact measurement, high spatial resolution and fast scanning speed, it has incomparable technical advantages in highway goaf deformation monitoring. Therefore, this paper mainly studies the application of 3D laser scanning technology in highway goaf deformation monitoring. The acquisition and processing of point cloud data in highway goaf monitoring are discussed in detail, including point cloud data acquisition method, stitching principle and method, point cloud filtering principle and surface reconstruction principle. It is found that the error of deformation monitoring by 3D laser scanning method is small, which indicates that 3D laser scanning technology can accurately and effectively monitor the settlement of linear buildings such as highways.

articleTitle: Computer intelligent recognition and studied of the pronunciation of Xiahe dialect database system through speech aerodynamics
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: This paper takes Xiahe dialect of Tibetan Amdo as the research object, and there is a special linguistic phenomenon in Xiahe dialect-compound consonants. The paper sorted out the compound consonant system of Xiahe dialect and showed the air flow waveform of different compound consonants. According to the analysis of the air flow parameters of different pre consonant pronunciation, it is concluded that the clarity of pre consonant has a certain impact on the pronunciation duration and average air flow speed.

articleTitle: Application of Artificial Intelligence Technology in Automatic Control of Electrical Engineering
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: With the rapid development of science and technology, artificial intelligence technology is widely used in various fields, which brings great convenience to the promotion of social production efficiency. Artificial intelligence technology has undoubtedly brought power and efficiency to the development of electrical automation. Applying artificial intelligence technology to electrical automation control can effectively promote the rapid development of electrical engineering automation control and give full play to the economic value of artificial intelligence.

articleTitle: A Real Time Scheduling Scheme For Food Delivery
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a comprehensive indicator consisting of distance, time pressure, and order revenue as the order selection criterion to help drivers choose the right order for multi-period food delivery problem. We model the order selection as a sequential decision-making problem, where the decision of assigning an order to a driver is determined from the driver's perspective. Then the routing problem is solved using nearest neighbor algorithm. Finally, through extensive simulation experiments, the proposed approach delivers improvement on the driver's efficiency and total revenue.

articleTitle: A new computer assisted design of shaftless pump for small fluid circuit by hydraulic calculation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: In this paper, a fluid circuit design scheme based on the new shaftless pump-jet technology is proposed, and its hydraulic performance is analyzed and calculated. This is a brand-new solution to the driving problem of the thermal control fluid circuit. At the same time, based on the shaftless pump-jet technology applied in ships and submarines, this paper abandons the traditional pump drive mode, optimizes the structure design, solves the leakage and hydraulic loss problems, and designs a new type of shaftless pump applied in small fluid circuit. After comparative analysis and comparison, the new shaftless pump has broad prospects in the application of fluid circuits.

articleTitle: Design of dual-model embedded finger vein and texture on dorsal recognition auto-guard system
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: In order to improve the convenience and safety of the auto-guard system, a dual-model biometric recognition system of finger vein texture on dorsal is applied. Finger vein recognition is a living recognition technology, which can effectively prevent spoof attacks. This paper uses Phytium Ft-2000/4 development board as the embedded development platform, and the debain10 operating system is mounted on it to simulate the on-board system. Combined with the self-designed image acquisition module, the core functions of near-infrared imaging, region of interest extraction, dorsal finger vein and finger dorsal texture extraction, matching and recognition are realized and it is applied to the business system of auto-guard to simulate the interaction and application among users, door lock and on-board system. Experiments show that the system is convenient, safe and reliable, and has strong application and popularization value.

Author Keywords: Finger vein and texture on dorsal

articleTitle: Research on multi-objective optimization of substation project management considering risk factors
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Along with the rapid development of economy in our country, the electricity load increasing, the country has increased demand for electric power project, increase gradually, to the requirement of transformer substation project decision makers is no longer just consider the project time limit, cost and quality to achieve the optimal standard, the construction of the influence factors of the risks is also important. However, different decision-makers have different attitudes towards risks and adopt different risk control strategies, which complicate the management of substation projects. In this paper, the risk factors are considered on the basis of the three classic indicators, and different risk control models are established combining the different attitudes of conservative decision makers and optimistic decision makers. The feasibility of multi-objective optimization is obtained by combining the branch-and-bound method and sine optimization group algorithm.

articleTitle: Imitating the Biological Vision Mechanism for Orientation Estimation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Local orientation is a kind of features of multi-dimensional signals. Orientation estimation play an important role in many image processing and computer vision tasks. This paper puts forward a revised orientation estimation algorithm called orientation bar chart for estimating local orientation imitating the biological vision mechanism described by the Geatalt law. The method calculates the vector addition of all neighboring voting for an object image pixel to get the orientation's bar chart and search out the peak value of the bar chart as its orientation angle. These orientation angles are used for later tensor voting process as orientation infor-mation. Two group of experiments are performed on typical contours to compare the contour completion effect and the accuracy. Experimental results on edge graph of city road show that the proposed algorithm works well for improving contour intaction, producing less clutter pixels and being robust to noises.

articleTitle: Design of Uimprove Knowledge Payment Platform Using Artificial Intelligence and Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: In recent years, the in-depth development of the Internet has given birth to the learning mode of knowledge payment. Since 2016 to date, knowledge payment has gone through the process of fumbling to maturity from its infancy to emergence, and its market scale has expanded, and is expected to reach $50 billion after 2020, with college students expected to account for up to $10 billion in the interim. In this explosion of the knowledge payment industry, countless platforms have emerged and grown. However, among the existing platforms, most of them target at the whole society, and the products are many and miscellaneous, with insufficient quality control ability and low product repurchase rate. Today, with the rapid development of distributed ledger and big data mining technologies, this situation can be precisely solved.

articleTitle: The data analysis and smart discriminant method based on fisher model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Fisher discriminant model was used to find the rule between discriminant factors and water quality types, and the discriminant function model of water inrush source was established, which was tested by water samples to be judged. On the basis of previous studies, the discriminant method model selects 6 kinds of conventional hydrochemical ions, pH and total dissolved solids, and a total of 8 kinds of hydrochemical factors to analyze.

articleTitle: A New Target Detection Scheme for Classroom Energy-saving System Based on YOLOv5s
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of using infrared pyroelectric sensors to identify and detect human bodies in traditional classroom energy-saving systems, there are problems such as susceptibility to environmental temperature, difficult wiring, high financial resources, and high maintenance costs. A YOLOv5s-based classroom energy-saving target detection is designed. Plan. This solution can use the existing camera in the classroom without changing the original classroom wiring, and use the deep learning method to realize the detection of human body and lamps. At the same time, data enhancement, K-means generating a priori boxes, NMS (Non-Maximum Suppression) and other mechanisms are introduced to the network model, and the target can be detected while counting the number of targets and outputting the positioning information of the target. Compared with the traditional single human body detection, the difference is that this solution also realizes the detection of the lighting status of the lamps. The experimental results show that the proposed model is applied to the classroom energy-saving system target detection with high detection accuracy and high recall rate, that is, the model has strong robustness and generalization ability, and can be effectively applied to the classroom energy-saving system.

articleTitle: A New Method for Feature Enhancement of Grid Equipment Images
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: With the continuous development of the state grid, power transmission equipment is also increasing, and how to efficiently inspect and maintain power transmission equipment has become a key concern in the industry. In order to reduce the consumption of manpower in the inspection process, the current method is mainly to send drones to take patrol photos and then use deep learning to identify faulty equipment. However, in the actual process, power transmission equipment is generally built in areas with more natural vegetation, so the pictures obtained from drones have problems such as unclear targets and too many irrelevant areas, which become the main factors affecting the effect of abnormality identification. Based on this, this paper proposes a method of image feature enhancement from the perspective of image processing, which can effectively improve the feature representation in the original image. Experiments are conducted on three datasets constructed by ourselves, and it can be seen that the image processing method proposed in this paper achieves good experimental results, which can effectively improve the detection effect of deep learning models on faulty equipment photos.

articleTitle: Research on the Computer Aided Design of Sensing Terminal System for Mass Transmission Equipment
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Design and research the sensing terminal system of mass transmission equipment, adopting modular design, including sensing modules. The system has a data analysis module and a protocol analysis module, which are sensed through image acquisition module, positioning module, temperature and humidity detection module and other perception modules. The terminal is connected to the user's mobile terminal through the Bluetooth module, 4G module, and server. The measurement equipment sensing terminal system has functions such as basic file sorting, physical and geographic topology information upload, hierarchical line loss accounting, metering box and power meter power outage report, early warning report of suspected electricity theft, environmental temperature and humidity monitoring, etc.

articleTitle: Research on the Computer Assisted Design of the Intelligent Information Platform Using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: The construction of the “credit bank chain” based on the “blockchain” technology has become an important starting point for the agglomeration and development of private higher education in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area. The informatization construction of the credit bank is not only one of the people's livelihood projects of the national vocational education, but also fully reflects the characteristics and needs of the current private higher education reform and development. At present, the construction of credit banks with new technologies such as blockchain, artificial intelligence, and big data has become an irreversible trend. The construction of an information platform for private higher vocational credit banks in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area supports the accumulation and transfer of credits between different private higher vocational schools by building a model for mutual recognition of learning achievements. And based on the blockchain technology to establish learners' lifelong learning files, create a cloud-chain integrated “credit bank chain”, reconstruct the trust system in the field of private vocational education, and form a lifelong education system that runs through pre-employment, mid-career, and post-employment. The agglomeration and development of private higher education has opened up the key link of mutual recognition of credits.

Author Keywords: Guangdong Hong Kong Macao Dawan district

articleTitle: Electricity Short-Term Load Computer Intelligent Forecasting Model under Robust Extreme Learning Machine and Numerical Simulation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: In the open market environment on the electricity sales side, market competition among multiple electricity sellers has brought about fluctuations in electricity prices, and electricity price-oriented consumer electricity consumption behavior has also changed accordingly, making the load curve more random and complicated. These bring more uncertainty to short-term load forecasting. In this paper, the influence factors of electricity price oriented demand are discussed, and a demand response model based on real-time price is proposed; then, based on robust extreme learning machine model, load multi-quantile and multi-scenario forecasting is realized. The simulation results show that the forecasting model can deal with the random interference factors in the market of power selling side and realize the accurate load forecasting.

articleTitle: The Network Distance Learning System Aided by Computer Information and Online Video Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: With the continuous development and progress of computer network technology, big data mining has been vigorously applied in various industries. The informatization of teaching and educational administration is an important part of the informatization of college education. The system designed in this paper adopts a three-tier structure development model to build a curriculum resource and teaching management system based on .NET technology as the core system plan. The article explores the realization of curriculum resources and teaching management platform solutions through WEB technology. The system revolves around the teaching resources and activities involved in the whole process of teacher's course teaching, and realizes the teaching plan, syllabus, teaching schedule, experiment arrangement, learning resources (multimedia resources, courseware, teaching and learning templates and tools, cases, Documents, student work) and other resource information on the Internet publishing, inquiries, browsing and updating. In addition, extracurricular supplementary teaching activities between teachers and students can be carried out through online Q&A, teacher-student exchanges and special discussions.

articleTitle: A Study on Power System Development Trend through Comptuer Visualization and Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Since the 21st century, the vigorous development of big data technology has led to its application in the electrical power systems, while some initial progress has been made in the research on the application of big data technology in the electric power system. This paper analyzes the application of big data technology in electric power system from the development status of big data technology as well as electric power system. The key technologies of the application of big data technology in the electric power system are divided into integration and management technology, data processing technology, data analysis technology and data visualization technology of electric power big data, and analyzed one by one. Meanwhile, this paper also lists the application examples of electric power mega data technology in smart grid, so as to confirm the development trend of electric power system under big data technology.

articleTitle: Video Anomaly Detection Based on Frame Prediction of Generative Adversarial Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: With the development of society, the application of abnormal behavior detection in the field of public safety has become more and more extensive. We propose a frame prediction video behavior anomaly detection model based on Generative Adversarial Network (GAN). We use the U-net network with the feature storage module and variance attention mechanism as the generator, which not only increases the network's sensitivity to the movement part of the sample, but also reduces the network's learning ability and limits the network's ability to predict abnormal samples. For the discriminant model, we have added a channel and spatial attention mechanism to the Markov discriminator to improve the discrimination ability, which is conducive to improving the quality of future frame generation. Compared with the existing abnormal behavior detection methods, our proposed model achieves excellent detection performance.

articleTitle: An authentication design of intelligent substation based on identity password
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: As the hub of power transfer in the power grid, intelligent substation undertakes many important functions, and its communication security transmission is an urgent problem to be solved. The previous research is mainly based on PKI signature technology, which brings a great burden to the system and network. This paper proposes an identity authentication method based on identity password to realize the identity authentication of communication subject in intelligent substation and key exchange for network layer secure communication. Finally, this paper analyzes the authentication of identity password from the performance, and proves theoretically that the identity password algorithm can meet the identity authentication of intelligent substation.

articleTitle: A semantic segmentation algorithm supported by image processing and neural network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: The accurate segmentation of the lesion area is of great significance to the actual medical treatment. However, the segmentation results of the current segmentation network are not accurate enough to provide guidance for actual medical treatment. To solve this problem, a improved U-Net segmentation network is proposed. Firstly. The residual module and new attention mechanism are introduced to optimize the encoder, and 2×2 convolution is used instead of pooling operation, which can refine and extract features while retaining spatial feature information. Secondly, the attention mechanism is introduced before the upsampling jump connection, so that the network pays attention to the spatial information of the low-level feature map. The improved U-Net segmentation network was evaluated on the LiTS datasets. Compared with the traditional If-Net, the Dice coefficient and recall rate are increased by 5.6% and 3.03 % respectively in the liver segmentation task, the Dice coefficient and recall rate are increased by 7.51% and 8.8% respectively in the liver tumor segmentation task.

articleTitle: Degradation analysis of analog sun sensor used by satellite in orbit
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: As an important measurement component of spacecraft attitude control system, the monitoring and analysis of solar sensor's performance is of great significance for spacecraft on-orbit management. During the long-term operation in orbit, the photoelectric conversion rate of the components of the analog sun sensor will be reduced due to the influence of the space environment such as charged particle damage and cumulative radiation damage, which will lead to the deterioration of the performance of the sun sensor. Therefore, this paper analyzes the correlation of the analog sun sensor, namely the photoelectric conversion process. Taking the photoelectric conversion rate of the sun sensor as the main object, the performance degradation model of the sun sensor is established. Finally, the telemetry data are analyzed from an orbiting spacecraft, and the index characteristics of the on-orbit performance degradation of the solar sensor components are analyzed by data fitting.

articleTitle: Hyperchaotic Image Encryption Algorithm Based on Dynamic DNA Coding
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: A color image encryption scheme based on DNA encoding and a hyperchaotic system is proposed. First, the plaintext image is converted into three DNA matrices, and the original image pixels are shuffled by the DNA encoding and chaotic sequence, then the two DNA matrices are separately exchange of DNA fragments in rows and columns. The chaotic sequence determines the matrices and DNA fragments that need to be exchanged, which can resist statistical attacks well, and then the S-box is generated according to the DNA random code and the chaotic sequence, which maps the scrambled matrix and finally recombines the three matrices to obtain the ciphertext. The simulation experiment shows that the image encryption system has good security and can resist various attacks.

articleTitle: Research on software development and test environment automation based on association rules
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: With the rapid increase of software demand and the continuous improvement of socialized production requirements, programmers are increasingly demanding on the performance of development tools. In the research of software development tool performance, intelligence is one of the hot research directions. At present, intelligent sensing technology is widely used in software development tools to assist users in development. However, the technology only plays a role in the automatic complement operation of input, and it can not provide more intelligent functions, such as the function information required by the user in the next step. In software development, the automation level of development and test environment directly affects the efficiency of software development. By adopting association rule algorithm, building automation architecture with Hypervisor layer and assisting with VMware Lab Manager testing tool, the software development and testing can be managed and optimized efficiently. This automation scheme can make the deployment and configuration of software development and testing environment more flexible.

articleTitle: A Smart Mobile Robotic Exoskeleton by Man-Machine Interaction Signal Processing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: A new mobile robotic hip exoskeleton has been presented to meet the early rehabilitation needs of patients with neurologically dysfunction, which can be controlled by the active motion intention of patients. This lower limb rehabilitation robot is composed of two exoskeleton orthotics and a robotic walker, providing an over-ground walking experience and an active torque to unload body weight. Several sensors are placed on the robot to detect motion intention and ensure safety. An autonomous control strategy is proposed to enhance user's active participation during gait rehabilitation. Kalman filter is used to process the human-machine interaction force signal, and the trajectory equation is obtained by fitting the referenced hip joint curve which extracted from the clinical gait analysis database. The result of designed experiments is in line with the expected performance, tracking error between the reference trajectory and the actual trajectory is about 1 deg.

articleTitle: Discussion of Computer Network and Electronic Communication Security in the Age of Information Digitization
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Since entering the information age, the flood of network information has caused many computer network security problems. This paper expounds an overview of the information age and computer network security problems, and proposes measures to deal with the computer network security problems in the information age.

articleTitle: An intelligent method of violation identification for power operation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Attitude analysis is widely used in various fields, but there is a lack of power operation behavior analysis. In order to realize the violation detection in the process of power operation, ROS and lidar information is used for auxiliary positioning, and OpenPose is used for skeleton extraction and detection. This paper proposes to detect the posture of power operators based on OpenPose, laying a foundation for the violation analysis of power operators. Finally, the algorithm is deployed on the edge processor Jetson Xavier NX. Experimental results show that the algorithm can perform pose detection analysis in the operation process of power operators and meet the requirements of subsequent violation analysis.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation Analysis of Ground Pre-extracted Coalbed Methane
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: In order to study the influence of different in-situ stress and gas pressure conditions on the effect of ground pre-extracted coalbed methane, according to the example of Jincheng mining area, based on the COMSOL numerical simulation software, with the stress of 5 MPa, 10 MPa, 15 MPa, 20 MPa and reservoir pressure of 1.0 MPa, 1.5 MPa, 2.0 MPa and 2.5 MPa, the effect of coal seam stress and reservoir pressure on the surface pre extraction of coal bed gas is studied. The results show that the increase of ground stress in coal seam makes the porosity of the matrix and the fracture tend to close, resulting in the decrease of permeability, the decrease of the flow rate of gas in the pores and cracks, and the decrease of gas production rate and gas production rate, and the pressure of the reservoir is positively related to the rate of coalbed methane production, and the higher the reservoir pressure is. The higher the production rate and the higher the total output, the higher the extraction time, the higher the permeability of coal seam, and the greater the reservoir pressure is, the more significant the change is.

articleTitle: A Novel Method to Develop MiniDB Using DBMS and Information Digitization
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: The existing commercial DBMS is too complex, which make it difficult for students to study DBMS. This paper proposes an novel method to build education oriented mini-DBMS with the support of MiniDB. MiniDB is a software architecture that supports user customized development. Based on MiniDB, some novel modules can be customized and aggregated to realize specific software instances. This paper presents a practical case of MiniDB to construct a education oriented DBMS, and shows the possibility and method of constructing a mini-DBMS with the cooperation of teachers and students. Our practice shows that it is feasible to develop the mini-DBMS which can reduce students' investment in the preliminary work of practice, and help students understand the principle of database through practice.

articleTitle: Analysis of Traffic Congestion around Nanjing Middle School Based on Floating Car Data
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: With the rapid development of social economy, the number of motor vehicles continues to grow, resulting in corresponding traffic congestion problems. Traffic congestion refers to the phenomenon of traffic detention caused by roads in a certain time and space that cannot meet the corresponding traffic demand and traffic supply. This paper is mainly based on floating car data, selecting 4 representative middle schools in Nanjing as the research object, and researching through the obtained floating car data and road condition information, mainly analyzing the main roads around the 4 middle schools in different time periods Congestion caused by the situation. Methods such as spatial statistical analysis and comparative analysis are used to analyze the school's spatial and temporal impact on traffic congestion. The results show that the school with more people has more influence on its surrounding main roads; the farther the surrounding roads are from the school, the lower the degree of congestion. The spatial impact of the school on the main roads around it mainly presents the characteristics of distance diffusion. The school's impact on the time of its surrounding main roads is reflected in the school time period of the working day.

articleTitle: Data processing and analysis of Xinjiang first order gravity network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: This paper introduces the technical scheme and process, key links and technologies, adjustment results and accuracy of data processing of Xinjiang first order gravity network. In the data preprocessing of Xinjiang first order gravity network, various corrections are taken into account, and rigorous mathematical models are adopted; in the adjustment, reliable methods and technologies such as “strong and weak benchmark” combined adjustment method and gross error test are adopted, which ensure the accuracy and reliability of the data processing results. After adjustment, the mean square error of all gravity points is ± 17.9×10<sup>−8</sup> ms<sup>−2</sup>, and the mean square error of the weakest point (XJ12 at Turgat station) is ± 30.6×10<sup>−8</sup> ms<sup>−2</sup>. It has positive reference significance and reference value for data processing of regional gravity reference network.

articleTitle: Study on pyrolysis characteristics of polyethylene outer sheath of 110kV power cable under overheating defect
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: The polyethylene (PE) outer sheath of power cable is easy to burn due to cable defect. Therefore, it is necessary to explore the pyrolysis characteristics of PE outer sheath of power cable to construct cable fire early warning technology. In this paper, the pyrolysis experiment of PE outer sheath of typical 110kV power cable in was done via thermogravimetry infrared spectrometer, the thermogravimetric analysis curve and differential thermogravimetric analysis curve of PE outer sheath under five different temperature rise conditions were obtained. The results shown that the mass fraction of the PE outer sheath in the initial stage will increase at the rates of 40, 60 and 80°C /min, and even exceed 100%. However, after the initial stage, the sample mass at the five temperature rise rates will decrease with the progress of the experiment. The mass loss rate only had one peak near 450°C under 10°C/min. However, The mass loss rate only had two peaks near 300°C and 450 °C under other four temperature rise rates.

articleTitle: Research on Anti-Phase Ambiguity Method for High Frame Rate Ultra-Short Baseline Location System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: The underwater acoustic location technique takes advantage of the long-distance propagation of underwater sound wave. With the help of transponder array, buoy or base array which placed in the already known position underwater, on the water or on hull, it can measure the propagation delay, phase difference and more of the acoustic signals that emitted by the target and the location of the target is calculated through geometrical principles. For systems operating at higher frequencies, due to the limitation of physical processes, the spacing of array elements is difficult to satisfy the constraint of half-wave spacing, and the traditional anti-phase ambiguity method is invalid. In order to solve this problem, an anti-phase ambiguity algorithm based on maximum a posterior criterion is investigated. After analyzing the feasibility of the algorithm in theory, the engineering implementation method is given. Then we discuss the influence of array on this method, and verify the accuracy of the method by simulation.

articleTitle: Blocking EMI Optimization of the Drive Circuit for an Intelligent High Side Power Switch
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Despite the advantages of a fast switching speed and a low power consumption, intelligent switch chips as a controlled power supply chip need to be electromagnetic compatible due to the complex working environment. Either injection of electromagnetic interference or the transistor's own parasitic capacitance due to the change to the transistor state can result in chip failure. This paper will introduce a novel optimization strategy of reducing (Electromagnetic interference) EMI for an intelligent high side power switch. The proposed circuit is characterized by a differential voltage comparator for a better tolerance of interference and it also exploits the single-term conductivity of the diode to block noise. Experimental results show that the improved method can suppress the electromagnetic interference effectively and improve the anti-jamming ability without increasing the chip die area. It has a wide application potential in improving the reliability of chips.

articleTitle: HarDNet-PSA: A High Precision Polyp Detection Neural Network with Attention Module
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Colorectal cancer is a common malignant tumor in the gastrointestinal tract. Regular colonoscopy to identify and remove polyps can help reduce the risk of the disease. With the development of computer image processing technology, the way of identifying intestinal polyps has developed from manual examination to machine recognition, with higher accuracy. Based on a convolutional neural network HarDNet-MSEG with low memory flow and high precision, a network HarDNet68 with high inference performance is used as the backbone, and three Receptive Filed Blocks and three Polarized Self-Attention modules are used for decoding in the U-shaped encoder-decoder architecture. By maintaining a relatively high resolution in the space and channel dimensions and combining the nonlinear functions Softmax and Sigmoid, the model will obtain better performance on pixel-wise task. The model is trained with Kvasir data set. Through experimental verification, the index Mean Dice of HarDNet-PSA on Kvasir is 0.911. In addition, HarDNet-PSA has excellent performance in meanIoU, MAE, Sm and meanEm.

articleTitle: Research on System Modeling Simulation and Application Technology Based on Electromechanical Equipment
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: The development process of mechatronics has developed rapidly with the progress of various technologies. With the development of mechatronics technology in the direction of intelligence, networking, fuzziness, flexibility and miniaturization, new requirements are put forward for the design methods of electromechanical products. The article describes the specific process of simulation design based on SolidWorks/MATLAB. With the help of the highly interactive and realistic 3D virtual space environment provided by this system, the seamless link between classroom theoretical study and factory field practice is realized, and the 3D picking validity judgment function of interactive points is helpful for students to dynamically and real-time manipulate and select objects in the virtual scene. Simulation experiments show that the system modeling and simulation model of electromechanical equipment has good prediction accuracy, and can be used to control, predict and evaluate the production process and the running state of equipment.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Automatic Testing System for Full Performance of Measuring Instruments
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: The automatic detection system for full-performance detection of measuring instruments mainly solves the problems of the existing detection platform body cannot be applied to the full-performance detection automatic detection line, cannot be compatible with a variety of tested equipment, low automation level, low detection efficiency, and large area. Design a multifunctional automatic detection device suitable for all types of intelligent electric energy meters, type I concentrators and type III special transformer collection terminals. Used in conjunction with the full-performance testing automated assembly line, error testing and functional testing of a variety of metering equipment can be completed without human intervention. It is conducive to the realization of intelligent optimization control of the detection process, and is conducive to the realization of the intelligent collection and management of detection data. Reduce equipment procurement and operation and maintenance costs, and improve resource utilization.

articleTitle: An Image Encryption Method for Object Detection Based on Chaotic System and DNA Sequence
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Existing image encryption algorithms for object detection have shortcomings such as small key space, poor anti-attack ability. Therefore, this paper proposes an encryption algorithm based on Logistic map, Chen system, and DNA sequence for object detection image encryption. The main idea is to dynamically generate a prediction frame based on the object detection network, encrypt the image block in the prediction frame for the first time, then encrypt the whole image. The key is employed to drive the Logistic map and Chen system to generate the chaotic sequences, which is used in DNA computing, scrambling, and diffusion operations. This paper describes the design of the encryption algorithm in detail and conducts security analysis, including histogram statistics, adjacent element correlation analysis, and information entropy analysis. The results show that the algorithm has good cryptographic characteristics and strong anti-attack, and can be used for object detection image encryption.

articleTitle: Dynamic path planning of UAV for three-dimensional moving target search in complex environment
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: In view of the fact that most of the current studies on path planning are limited to the fixed target or the static environment, a path planning method of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) for three-dimensional moving target search in complex environments is proposed. In this method, the interactive maneuvering model is used to predict the motion state of the target, and then using the idea of hierarchical planning for reference, the guidance point is generated by the weighted sparse A star algorithm, which is combined with the model predictive control algorithm. The motion state of the target can be estimated more accurately, and the UAV can respond in real time accordingly. By introducing the large step strategy in the stage of weighted sparse A star algorithm, not only the time cost of path planning can be reduced, but also the infeasible areas in complex environment can be avoided in real time. The simulation results show that this method has strong predictability for environmental change and target motion, so as to guide the UAV to respond in advance and get a better path while meeting the real-time requirements.

articleTitle: Typical forage image recognition method based on U-Net network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: In view of the low degree of monitoring and digitization of desertification grassland in Inner Mongolia, this paper constructs an improved network model based on U-Net network and Mobile network based on using unmanned air vehicle to obtain images of desertification grassland. The typical forage grasses stipa longiflora, kochia prostrate, alfalfa, vicia costata and agropyron cristatum in decertified grassland were classified and distinguish. The experimental results show that the improved U-Net network model can effectively realize the classification and identification of forage grass. The Kappa value of the network model is 84.8%, the overall accuracy is 89.9%, and the classification result is reliable. It can provide a scientific basis for monitoring vegetation species diversity, grass species degradation and pest control.

articleTitle: Forecasting Methods of Big Data Based on Machine Learning and Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: The history of credit cards could date back to 1950s. Credit card gradually become one of the main forms of payment for people. In this case, the default risk has become one of the biggest problems in credit risk and how to identify this risk is more and more important. This report aims to solve the problem about identification of default risk in bank before the credit extension or other service. The main solutions for this problem at present are setting black and white list, fixed threshold filtering. However, these two solutions have a lot of drawbacks: 1. They cannot be used to deal with a large number of loan transactions. 2. They take a lot time to complete estimation, which is not efficient. 3. The accuracy of these methods is low. Based on these drawbacks, I put forward methods by using machine learning to predict whether the borrowers will default.

articleTitle: Application of Intelligent Identification Technology on Oil and Gas Fields
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Intelligent construction is an important direction of oil and gas field development at present, and is an inevitable way for oil and gas field development transformation, low cost strategy demand and innovative development. In this paper, intelligent identification technology used in oil and gas fields is introduced. Combined with the field monitoring requirements of oil and gas fields, the application of intelligent identification technology is analyzed from the unique scenarios of well station intrusion identification, field safety monitoring and unattended, and the future application prospect of intelligent identification technology in oil and gas fields is forecasted.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Interactive Intelligent Melody Arrangement System through Deep Learning and Artificial Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: In recent years, the rapid development of deep learning techniques has promoted the research of automatic music generation techniques, effectively avoiding the over-reliance of traditional machine learning methods on music knowledge rules and manually designed features, and achieving better results in complex music generation tasks. However, deep neural networks are very difficult to control the behavior of neural models flexibly due to the lack of good interpretability. Most of the current research on neural music generation has mainly focused on fully automated generation tasks with little attention to interactivity. To address these problems, this paper proposes a variational self-encoder for melody generation based on contour label sequence control. The method achieves modeling of local contour features of melodies by unsupervised learning of conditional autoregressive tasks from melodic contour labels automatically inferred by the model; latent variable encoding of melodies using variational inference compensates for the former's deficiency in modeling global attributes.

articleTitle: Mathematical Statistics and Analysis on the Path Mechanism of Protecting Personal Information Relying on Information Digitization and Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: The value of personal information in the era of digital economy is getting higher and higher, and it has become the focus of all groups of the whole society. Commercial banks maintain high-quality personal information resources, and such information is directly related to personal privacy, so they need to perform special information security protection duties compared with ordinary personal information processors. The promulgation of Chinese Civil Code provides basic legal protection for the protection of personal information. Commercial banks should pay attention to the relevant provisions of the Civil Code, use and deal with personal information in a scientific, reasonable and lawful way, and ensure the privacy of natural persons.

articleTitle: Study on Precise Calculation of Three-Dimensional Fracture of Alloy Using Computer MA TLAB Program and Finite Element Method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: For structures with multiple cracks in engineering, fractures are often not simple straight penetrating fractures, and in most cases may be non-penetrating surface cracks or curvilineal cracks. In practice, the actual crack shape is usually taken as a straight penetrating fracture. However, this processing method often leads to decreased calculation accuracy, and in some cases, it will get over-conservative results, so that the material properties are not fully developed. Therefore, it is necessary to conduct three-dimensional (3D) fracture propagation and fracture analysis based on the actual shape of the crack front.

articleTitle: Clustering Research Based on Ship Trajectory Density and DBSCAN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Automatic Identification System (AIS) is composed of shore base station facilities and shipboard equipment. It is a new type of digital navigation aid system and equipment that integrates network technology, modern communication technology, computer technology and electronic information display technology. Automatic ship identification system can provide communication and management between ships and between ships and shore base stations, so in the process of navigation informatization, AIS has received more and more attention. The message data of the automatic ship identification system contains a large amount of information about ships at sea. In order to find the movement rules of ships in a specific area in the AIS data, Improved DBSCAN algorithm based on ship trajectory segment density was proposed. The improved DBSCAN clustering algorithm is used to perform clustering analysis on the real AIS track segment data instead of the whole trajectory. The experimental results show that the improved DBSCAN algorithm can get the common track within the region, and can improve the accuracy of clustering to a certain extent, which lays a foundation for the further analysis of abnormal ship behavior.

articleTitle: Research on Data Collection and Catastrophe Index Using Grey Relational Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Based on the flood disaster loss data during1980-2019 in various prefectures of Tarim Basin. Disaster loss indicators are: disaster area, collapsed house, deaths toll, dead livestock, collapsed shed. By calculating the catastrophe index and using the gray correlation analysis method to compare the risk level of disaster loss in each prefecture. Disaster loss of Aksu has the greatest correlation with the damage area. In Bazhou prefecture, it has the greatest correlation with the dead livestock. In Hotan prefecture, it has the greatest correlation with the collapsed shed. In Kashgar prefecture, it has the greatest correlation with the disaster area. And in Kezhou prefecture, it has the greatest correlation with the dead livestock. It should be noted that the correlation degree of dead livestock caused by floods in Kezhou prefecture and the correlation degree of collapsed shed caused by floods in Hotan prefecture are higher (R>0.8). The risk analysis of flood disaster loss in Tarim Basin is significant for disaster management.

articleTitle: Design of Monitoring System of Injection Pump Based on IoT
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Aiming at the current medical equipment market demand for information transmission and monitoring system of drug injection pump with low energy consumption and high stability, a wireless remote information transmission system with low cost and high reliability based on Bluetooth low energy (BLE) communication was proposed. The BLE modules are used to build Mesh network in the wireless information sending terminal to expand the transmission distance of a single device. The WiFi modules are used in the relay devices to upload the information transmitted by the terminal to the server. The monitor realizes real-time monitoring of four data, namely injection speed, battery power, remaining dosage and working time through the web page. The system can transmit data and information safely and reliably with low packet loss rate for a long time and low delay, saving manpower consumption effectively.

articleTitle: Research on the Microscopic Mechanism and Thermal Characteristics of Electron Emission of Safe Spark Test
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: The electro-thermal effect is accompanied by the electrothermal effect when the safety spark test electrode breaks the inductance circuit, which plays a key role in electron emission, making the cathode a source of thermal field emission. In-depth analysis of the microscopic morphology of the surface of the test electrode, so as to establish a physical model of the micro-protrusions on the surface of the test electrode of the cadmium disc. Deduced the mathematical expression of the electron emission current density under the action of heat conduction-field, and numerically calculated the relationship between the thermal field-induced current density and temperature of different electrode materials, and found that the tungsten wire and cadmium disk electrode electrons emit electrons during the arc-building phase of the inductance circuit The mechanism is different. Based on this, numerical simulation of the effect of different applied electric fields on the temperature of micro-protrusions on the surface of the cadmium disk electrode has laid a theoretical foundation for further research on the mechanism of inductive breaking and arcing.

articleTitle: Study on computer modeling and calculation of 500kV ultra-high voltage transmission towers
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: In the design of 500kV ultra-high voltage transmission towers in mountainous areas, the choice of tower slope will affect the size of the tower's root opening, thereby affecting the applicability of the tower in mountainous areas. At the same time, the choice of tower slope will also cause the tower weight and foundation force to be generated. Differences, thereby affecting the construction cost of the project. Combining actual engineering, taking a 20mm ice zone 53ZBC33 tower type for a 500kV line project as an example, a total of 8 different slopes of 0.09~0.16 for transmission towers of 60m, 54m, 48m, and 42m are calculated. The tower is used as an example. Steel quantity cost, foundation cost, and tower foundation land compensation fee are used as indicators to compare and analyze the project cost. When the calling height of the transmission tower is different, the corresponding economic slope is slightly different, but the overall economic slope fluctuates in the range of 0.10~0.13. In the actual design process, the economic slope of the tower can be quickly calculated in the slope range of 0.10~0.13.

articleTitle: Metro Neighborhood Construction Monitoring System Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: In order to avoid impact of illegal construction and wrong construction along the rail transit, it is necessary to build an environmental monitoring and alarm system. This study uses Mel Frequency Cepstrum Coefficient (MFCC) as the sound feature to build a neural network model to identify the construction sound to monitor whether the construction is in progress in the non construction area. Thanks to the long-distance transmission and low power consumption characteristics of Lora, the identification result is transmitted from the device node to the PC, so the administrator can view the status information of each device node in real time. At last, the accuracy of sound classification and recognition is as high as 99.6%.

articleTitle: Application of Big Data and Computer 3D Simulation Technology in the Assistance of Training by Database System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Aiming at the current sports training management in Chinese universities, based on the multi-Agent mode, analyze the design requirements of the decision-making system, and combine the overall structure design, functional design and software code implementation to design and implement the college sports training management decision-making system. Practice shows that the system can provide decision-making support for group students or individual students in physical fitness assessment and sports training, and provide a scientific theoretical basis for formulating corresponding training plans.

articleTitle: Computer Aided Design and Development of a Intelligent Information Test System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Facing the needs of comprehensive testing and maintenance support for large-scale naval equipment, in accordance with the design principles of generalization, modularization, serialization, intelligence, and integration, in response to problems such as difficult injection of faults, high risks, long cycles, and high costs in testable physical verification tests, Establish an equipment test index system, design and develop a test management system for test appraisal. On the basis of breakthroughs in key technologies such as virtual instrument hardware platform, test interface and software platform generalization, a generalized solution for large-scale complex equipment test identification integrated test [1] is realized.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach for Solving Light Reflections on the Blackboard by Machine Vision Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: As the light reflection problem keeps bothering students around the world, we thought of a novel approach to solve the problem through a blackboard that can rotate itself. In this project, mechanical design and embedded technology are used. And used 3D printing to process some parts. Verified the performance of the equipment through experiments. This can prevent the light reflections from interrupting the students.

articleTitle: Aspect-words Sentiment analysis of commodity comments based on deep memory network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: The social model is a huge virtual platform where to freely express themselves and give their views and feelings, influencing any aspect of life, with implications for marketing and communication alike. Aspect words sentiment analysis can more accurately understand user needs and improve enterprise marketing strategies. In current researches on aspect words sentiment analysis, researchers use the integration of attention mechanism and LSTM to obtain key information. However, there are few studies on the fusion of aspect words, context, and multi-layer deep memory networks. Therefore, we proposed a multi-layer deep memory network model based on the splicing of aspect terms and context vectors. The model can further strengthen the fusion between aspect words and context vectors, and make up for the shortcomings of LSTM in transmitting information loss. Experimental results on Restaurant and Laptop datasets show that the proposed method has a better performance.

articleTitle: A novel method for constraint creation of human long bone model based on hierarchical semantic mapping
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: The significant advantage of human long bone feature model is anatomical semantics, which can help medical personnel quickly identify and describe individual bone feature information. In this study, a constraint construction method of femoral surface model based on hierarchical parameter mapping is proposed to ensure the rationality of the deformed model by associating the variation range of characteristic parameters. The experimental results show that based on the modification of feature parameters, users can realize the rapid deformation of local feature regions and the constraint reconstruction of the whole model.

articleTitle: Research of Information Management System by Big Data Algorithm and Computer visualization
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: The article not only analyzes the impact of the big data value chain on the four processes of forecasting, decision-making, control and evaluation from the perspective of financial activities, but also analyzes the impact of big data technology on stakeholders from the perspective of financial the talents analyze the challenges in the application of big data. At the end of the article, an enterprise financial management information system is established based on computer big data algorithms. Combining SWT technology here, we elaborate on the specific design of the enterprise financial management system, and use actual operations in the financial system implementation to demonstrate the financial system process through the system interface. The graphical user interface developed based on SWT realizes corporate finance. The main function of management. Practice has shown that the system is not only simple to operate, but also has a friendly interface. It is a flexible, reliable, fully functional and practical information management system.

articleTitle: Optimal Time Five Voltage Vector Finite-set Model Predictive Control
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: In this paper, the five space vector modulation method is adopted on the basis of the traditional finite-control-set model predictive control, which can effectively to reduce the common mode voltage, and suppress the switching losses. The delay compensation is added to the finite-control-set model predictive control to construct the cost function of reducing the deviation from the output current, and calculate the optimal action time of the five vectors. The experiment verifies that the optimal time five voltage vector finite-set model predictive control effectively dropped down the common-mode voltage, improved the symmetry of the three-phase output current and the waveform quality.

articleTitle: Research on Semantic Interaction Integration Method and Key Technology for Edge Intelligent Instrument
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Considering the networking, digitization and intelligence development trend for the traditional instruments, this paper proposes a general method of semantic interaction integration for the edge intelligent instrument, introduces the key techniques about semantic database, information model, uniform model description and semantic shell, etc., constructs a verification system, and performs the experiment verification on the basis of edge intelligent temperature transmitter, whose results conform to the expectations. This method is a general paradigm in semantic interaction integration. It is not only suitable for the instruments but also useful for the semantic interaction integration for CNC and industrial robot, which plays an important role in promoting the transition of industrial digitization.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Information System Using Computer Big Data and Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Based on computer big data technology, the article analyses the importance and current situation of enterprise management, discusses the functional requirements of enterprise management system based on Intranet/Internet, and develops an enterprise management system based on the coding system. The system has been tried out in some research institutes and enterprises and has achieved satisfactory results.

articleTitle: Prediction of Container Throughput in Guangdong Province Based on Different Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: The in-depth implementation of the “One Belt, One Road” has improved the development of the port economy and perfected the the functions of ports in Guangdong. Therefore, accurate forecasting of the port container throughput is essential for port planning and resource coordination. Taking Guangdong port as an example, the article uses ARIMA, GM (1, 1), ES, ES-GM (1, 1) and ES-ARIMA models to simulate and predict port container throughput. The results show that the optimal model for port throughput prediction is ES-GM (1, 1). In the next five months, the average increase in container port throughput was 2.14 wTEU. Finally, based on the forecast results, suggestions are made for the future development of the port.

articleTitle: Gas Adsorption and Desorption Performance of Coal with Different Degree of Metamorphism
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Starting from the gas pore stress of coal, the low-temperature nitrogen adsorption test is used to investigate the micropore characteristics of coal with different metamorphic degrees and its influence on gas adsorption/desorption, and to clarify the relationship between the initial rate of gas adsorption and desorption in coal and the pore stress. The experimental study was carried out by using self-built test equipment to simulate the actual formation. The results showed that: as the degree of coal metamorphism increases; the initial rate of gas adsorption and desorption is proportional to the pore stress of the coal seam, and the desorption capacity is stronger than the adsorption capacity within the same experimental period. In the same experiment time, the desorption capacity is stronger than the adsorption capacity, and the pore stress has a linear relationship with the initial rate of adsorption and desorption.

articleTitle: An optimized fusion positioning algorithm based on BP neural network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Multi-source fusion positioning is an effective approach when the positioning accuracy is unsatisfactory. To achieve accurate and continuous pedestrian positioning in complex indoor environments, we propose an optimized fusion positioning algorithm based on BP neural network. Firstly, the average positioning error of Wi-Fi is utilized to constrain the geomagnetic matching range. Secondly, Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) is used to optimize the BP-AdaBoost ensemble learning algorithm, then the optimized BP-AdaBoost-PSO is used to fuse Wi-Fi positioning results and constrained geomagnetic positioning results. Simulation results indicate that the constraint method can reduce the positioning error caused by the geomagnetic mismatch, and the proposed fusion positioning algorithm can reduce the average execution time and improve the positioning accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Smart Logistics and Distribution Path Optimization Using Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Against the background of increasingly severe energy consumption and environmental pollution, the development of a low-carbon economy is an inevitable trend for China to achieve sustainable development. Logistics, as a large energy consumption and greenhouse gas emissions major, has attracted much attention to its low-carbon operation mode. It is crucial to study the problem of vehicle routing from a low-carbon perspective to reduce the carbon emissions of cold chain logistics. This paper analyzes the main problems of vehicle path optimization from a low-carbon perspective by comparing relevant domestic and foreign literatures, discusses their solutions, and proposes prospects for future research.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Joint Commissioning System for Telecontrol Information Based on IEC61850
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: A telecontrol information intelligent joint debugging system based on IEC61850 is proposed. The influence of the substation telecontrol system and the communication mode on the intelligent joint debugging and test is analyzed, and the specific application of the intelligent substation joint debugging technology at the present stage is analyzed. The specific system of 104 telecontrol protocol is explained, and the telecontrol information intelligent joint debugging system based on the protocol is analyzed, and the system architecture and system functions as well as the system software structure are designed, and the master station information joint debugging decoupling technology is put forward, and the corresponding functional modules are explained.
