Finally, a 110kV substation is taken as an example to illustrate the effect of implementing the scheme proposed in this article and verify its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Application of Artificial Neural Network in TTU Frequency Analysis Module
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: In order to estimate the frequency of voltage and current signal in transformer terminal unit effectively, this paper applies artificial neural network (ANN) to estimate the signal frequency. The principle of ANN method is introduced, the structure, input and output of the neural network for frequency estimation is determined, and a computer program is written to implement ANN. The results show that the frequency estimation error is only about 0.1 mHz. On this basis, the influence of number of hidden layers, number of hidden layer neurons and goal on the accuracy of frequency estimation is investigated. The results show that the number of hidden layers have little effect on the frequency estimation error. With the increase of the number of hidden layer neurons, the frequency estimation error decreases gradually. The error remains pretty much the same when the number of hidden layer neurons larger than fifty. Therefore, it is suggested to be set to fifty. The frequency estimation error increases with goal. Taking into account all of these factors, the mean squared error is suggested to be set to 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−8</sup> HZ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation Research on Light Scattering Characteristics of Coal Dust Particles
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: In order to improve the current light scattering method dust concentration detection accuracy and optimize the design of the light scattering method dust concentration detection unit, the light scattering characteristics of coal dust are numerically simulated by author in this article. The article first explained the Mie scattering theory of dust particles, and designed the MATLAB numerical simulation process of Mie scattering theory, and determined the calculation method of Mie scattering coefficient. The influence curve of dust particle refractive index, laser wavelength and scattering angle on the scattered light intensity of different particle size dust was calculated by numerical simulation. The influence of three factors on the intensity of scattered light is determined. The imaginary part of particle refractive index, the laser wavelength, and the scattering angle have a significant influence on the scattered light intensity of the dust of each particle size. The wavelength of laser light is smaller, the greater the intensity of scattered light. The dust particle size is larger, the stronger the scattered light intensity. The scattered light intensity of the dust particle size of 1um-10um is concentrated in the small forward angle range, and this angle becomes smaller as the particle size increases.

articleTitle: Research on Battery Performance Assessment Technology by Artificial Neural Network and Intelligent Computing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Generally speaking, the normal work of satellite batteries is indispensable of the successful completion of the tasks undertaken by satellites. Therefore, in order to ensure the successful completion of the tasks, it is very meaningful to use on-orbit measured data to evaluate the health status of satellite batteries. At present, how to allocate the weight of each evaluation index is a difficult problem in equipment health assessment. In order to achieve the goal of automatic learning optimization of index weights, this paper evaluates the health status of a typical satellite battery by using artificial neural network calculation method. The results show that the coincidence between the calculated results of artificial neural network and the actual state of satellite accumulator in orbit is 100%, which effectively guarantees the accuracy of the evaluation.

articleTitle: A Binocular Distance Measurement Method with ORB Features in Region of Interest
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Traditional binocular distance measurement techniques require high-precise cameras and have large complexities. In order to improve the accuracy with images taken by normal cameras, we propose a binocular distance measurement method to effective oriented fast and rotated brief features in region of interest (BRI _ ORB). In the method, the binocular camera takes Zhang Zhengyou calibration method to calibrate. Then, the feature points of the region of Interest image are extracted by the ORB features extraction method, and takes RANSAC (Random Sample Consensus) eliminate mismatches. Finally, a nonlinear camera model is established to optimize the measurement distance value. Experimental results show that our method outperforms than the traditional techniques.

articleTitle: Research on WSN Routing Based on Pheromone Factor of Improved Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: In order to achieve the security and efficiency of data transmission in Wireless Sensor Networks(WSN), this paper improves the routing protocol based on pheromone concentration factor in ant colony algorithm. By introducing the comprehensive trust degree, this problem is transformed into a combinatorial optimization problem to balance the relationship among node trust value, node energy and link quality, so as to find the comprehensive optimal path. Unlike ordinary wireless routing protocols, this paper also takes into account the security of routing transmission, the load of the overall system, and the stability of message transmission. At the same time, in the routing maintenance part, it can also make use of the trend of trust value slowly decreasing to quickly adjust the nodes with insufficient energy or low trust in the system. Through experimental test and analysis, the improved routing protocol greatly promotes the efficiency of data transmission in WSN, thus prolonging the network life cycle.

articleTitle: Health Monitoring of Milling Cutters with Nonlinear Entropy and Self-organizing Mapping
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: The cutter is one critical component in a milling tool, and its operational condition directly affects the part machining quality and production efficiency. In this paper, a new method for milling cutters health monitoring is proposed. The proposed method extracts nonlinear entropy features with adaptive decomposition of the original multi-sensor monitoring signals. Then the extracted features are selected and adaptively fused into a virtual health indicator (HI) by self-organizing mapping (SOM) network to characterize the operational health condition of the milling cutter. High speed milling data from 2010 prognostics and health management (PHM) challenge is studied to demonstrate performance of the presented method. Experimental results show that the approach can effectively integrate the online multi-sensor signals to reliably describe health degradation of the milling cutter.

articleTitle: Structure design of elastomer of miniature six-axis force/torque sensor based on Y-type beam
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: In order to meet the measurement requirements of the end force of the robot finger, this paper designs a miniature six-axis force/torque sensor based on the Y-shaped beam. Mechanical modeling, static analysis, bridge selection and least square method decoupling are carried out on the proposed six-axis force/torque sensor, which ensures the feasibility of the scheme and measurement accuracy.

articleTitle: Classroom Brightness Detection Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: In the classroom energy-saving system, the traditional method of using the illuminance sensor to detect brightness has problems such as wiring difficulties, equipment failure, low detection accuracy, and the need for regular replacement of equipment. Without changing the original wiring layout of the classroom, using the existing cameras in the classroom and adopting the deep learning method based on image processing has the advantages of saving money, high feasibility, and high accuracy. First, the HSV color model is used to obtain the average brightness value of the image, and then the optimizer is used to obtain the best threshold for light and dark classification. The data set is labeled with light and dark through the best threshold. To make up for the lack of data set, use random scaling and cropping to the data After enhancement, the VGG convolutional neural network is used for training, and the accuracy of bright and dark classification reaches 99.6%. At the same time, it is compared with the deep neural network algorithm and the day and night classification algorithm, it is found that using the VGG convolutional neural network for bright and dark classification has the best effect.

articleTitle: Mathematical Prediction Model of Power Grid Engineering via Data Mining and Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: In the early stage of electric power engineering construction, the relevant departments of electric power enterprises need to publish the equipment information price regularly according to the historical information of the equipment price of power grid engineering. At the same time, the market price of equipment materials is affected by many internal and external factors. In order to reduce the fluctuation of cost level from research to completion and production and improve the accuracy of capital allocation, this paper adopts advanced data mining means to identify the main factors that affect the cost level of power grid projects, and to predict and control them. Therefore, it is necessary to correctly grasp the changing trend of equipment material price and strengthen the analysis and prediction of equipment material price in order to help to estimate the cost of electric power project reasonably, optimize the investment strategy and reduce the investment risk of the project.

articleTitle: Exploring the high consequence zone classification of gas gathering pipelines containing hydrogen sulphide
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: In view of the problems in the classification of high consequence zones of sulphur-bearing collector pipelines, firstly, the factors influencing the classification of high consequence zones of sulphur-bearing collector pipelines were analysed; secondly, the computational fluid dynamics simulation software FLACS was used to simulate the leakage of sulphur-bearing collector pipelines, and a rapid calculation model of the potential influence radius of leakage of sulphur-bearing collector pipelines was proposed; on this basis, a proposal for the classification of high consequence zones of sulphur-bearing collector pipelines was put forward, and an empirical On the basis of this, a high consequence zone classification proposal for sulphur-bearing gathering pipelines was proposed and empirically studied.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm Based on Double Random
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: The number of populations in a multi-objective particle swarm optimization has a significant impact on the performance of the algorithm, so this paper explores whether the number of non-inferior solutions in the external archive also affects the performance of the algorithm. This paper proposes multi-objective particle swarm optimization algorithm based on double random(DRMOPSO). In this paper, the results are verified by experimental simulations and a relatively good interval of non-dominated solutions is obtained. According to this interval the double random strategy formed by grid technique and mixed ranking strategy is controlled within the interval of better non-dominated solutions to improve the probability of particles flying to the true Pareto front. The simulative experimental results show that the algorithm in this paper has better convergence and diversity compared with MOPSO.

articleTitle: An Improved Simulated Annealing Algorithm for Fleet Size and Mix Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: The fleet size and mix vehicle routing problem with time windows (FSMVRPTW) is an important extended type of vehicle routing problem, and it has been proved to be a NP-hard problem in combinatorial optimization, which is difficult or impossible to obtain optimal solutions in large-scale cases. A four-step improved simulated annealing algorithm is proposed, which obtains a good initial solution through the construction of the first three steps and introduces four local search operators to iterate in the fourth step. To evaluate its performance, we test it with Solomon's VRPTW benchmark problems. The computational results demonstrate that the high -quality solutions can be obtained by using the new algorithm within an accepted computational time.

Author Keywords: fleet size and mix vehicle routing problem with time windows

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Computer Artificial Intelligence Technology in the Field of Network Security
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: A wireless sensor network is composed of a large number of sensor nodes with limited resources. In order to ensure the secure communication between sensor nodes, it is very important to find an effective key management method. In order to ensure that the data monitored by the wireless sensor network will not be illegally eavesdropped, tampered with or destroyed during the transmission process, we propose a computer artificial intelligence dynamic hybrid key management scheme based on the clustered structure of the wireless sensor network. Each cluster head randomly generates a sub-key matrix, and the cluster head uses a dynamic base key to assign a different one-way communication key to each member node. The scheme adopts the key chain segment activation method, which can effectively resist the security threat caused by the node capture attack, and has good security performance; it supports node redeployment, which can ensure good network coverage.

articleTitle: Research on Medical Image Registration Comparison Based on Algorithm Stitching Optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: With the development of medical technology, the problem of medical image registration is becoming more and more prominent. Two CT images were performed on the same patient. During the time difference between the two images, different degrees of lesions may occur in the detected part. However, due to the softness of human tissue and the automatic zooming of the image when the equipment finally outputs, the image size and rotation angle of the two outputs lose contrast.

articleTitle: Research on Remote Intelligent Platform and Automatic Monitoring System of Transformer Substations
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: With the increasing contradiction between less people and more stations and the development of front-end state sensing technology, data transmission technology and intelligent diagnosis technology, in order to effectively lighten the work strength of operation and maintenance staff and improve the operation and maintenance efficiency, we put forward the construction scheme of remote intelligent management platform, which makes use of modern information technology and advanced communication technology like the existing mobile Internet and artificial intelligence to realizes “Internet of Everything” and human-computer interaction at all stations under the jurisdiction, so as to make it an intelligent service system featuring comprehensive state perception, efficient information processing and convenient and flexible application.

articleTitle: Noise Analysis Based on Frequency Domain for Vehicle Voice Denoising
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: In the process of driving a vehicle, a good sound quality experience is essential for the driver. However, in the real-time audio and video communication, because the wireless voice of the vehicle will inevitably be interfered by various internal and external environmental noises during the transmission process, this will makes the original pure voice become noisy voice polluted by noise, thus, the quality of wireless voice communication is seriously affected. And it is inevitable that we will encounter various undesirable sounds, such as current noise, exhaust noise, etc. In this article, we analyze the types of vehicle noise that may exist in real life, and use the robustness of the existing traditional filter model to different noises, and select the best model. Finally, we improve the voice quality of the vehicle.

articleTitle: A new traffic accident risk prediction method based on adaptive neural fuzzy inference system
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: To address the problem of traffic accident risk prediction, this paper conducts a study of objective factors by means of a fuzzy neural network system. The fuzzy neural network system includes fuzzy-based traffic accident risk prediction inference system which is used to derive traffic accident rules and adaptive neural network for traffic accidents factors learning which is adopted to self-learn and adjust the error. The interpretability of the fuzzy inference system combined with the powerful learning capability of neural networks allows fuzzy neural networks, not only predicts traffic accident risk but also translates the prediction process into interpretable and clear human language to facilitate further research on countermeasures. In this study, the data of 2017–2019 traffic accidents in Louis Anna state of United States were utilized as training and testing. Temperature, visibility, wind speed, and humidity were selected as independent variables and traffic accident severity as dependent variables for modeling. After experiments as well as comparisons, this method can achieve a prediction accuracy of about 78%, which is better than deep neural network and k-nearest-neighbor in machine learning algorithms, and the Gaussian-bell membership function applied is also the affiliation function with the best results.

articleTitle: Design of New Micro-Nano Aerator
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of discontinuous process and low efficiency of traditional aerator by dissolved and released gas method, a new structure of micro-nano aerator with double dissolved gas tank was designed. After this design by getting water, oxygen, divided into hypoxia under the condition of the start-up mode and the remote control of the mobile phone app, can produce efficiently and large specific surface area is big, slow pressurization dissolved itself, the problem of high rate of gas dissolved, micro-nano bubbles, water, increasing oxygen in water environmental governance is important aspects of research and application value.

articleTitle: Correlation Analysis and Test of the Development Trend of Photovoltaic Building Integration Plate Index Based on EMA
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Under the goal of peak carbon dioxide emissions and carbon neutrality, how to achieve carbon neutrality in the construction industry with the label of “major carbon emitters” has attracted much attention, and the integration of building photovoltaics is welcoming, and its application scenarios are expanding gradually. In this paper, a processing and forecasting model of the integrated photovoltaic building model is established. Firstly, the standard moving average model is established, and the moving average line of the plate index from April 1,2019 to April 30,2021,2021 is drawn. Then the covariance matrix method is used to analyze the correlation between the Shanghai Composite Index and the integration of photovoltaic building. Through the correlation analysis of the end-point factors under MATLAB environment, the best correlation between them is solved. In this paper, the association model, prediction model and optimization model are integrated, and the constraints conditions of the optimization model are obtained through correlation analysis and prediction.

articleTitle: Research on transmission system optimization of hydrogen fuel cell vehicle based on Simulink
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: The fixed transmission system of fuel cell electric vehicle (FCEV) has a serious impact on fuel economy. This paper attempts to further optimize the fixed gear transmission system of FCEV from meeting the convenience of operation and further improving fuel economy. Firstly, the dynamic model of the transmission system of hydrogen fuel cell car is established, and then the transmission system is further optimized and analyzed based on MATLAB / Simulink. The results show that the economy and power performance of the optimized fixed gear transmission system can be significantly improved.

Author Keywords: Optimization of fixed gear transmission system

articleTitle: Influence of Stator Notch Size on Torque of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Torque is an important index of permanent magnet synchronous motor design. Torque optimization is mainly divided into how to improve output torque and reduce torque ripple. Taking the surface-mounted permanent magnet synchronous motor as an example, this paper changes the stator notch size, and finds out the relationship between the stator notch size and the output torque and torque ripple through finite element simulation. The simulation shows that adjusting the stator notch size can optimize the motor torque, which provides a reference for the subsequent torque optimization design of surface-mounted permanent magnet synchronous motor.

articleTitle: Mathematical Analysis on Power Load Characteristics and Index Using Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Since the reform and opening up, my country's small and medium-sized enterprises have made considerable progress and occupy an increasingly important position in the development of the national economy, whether in terms of absorbing social employment, invigorating the urban and rural economy, or paying taxes, promoting economic growth, and developing technology Innovation and other aspects have made important contributions. However, in the development process of my country's SMEs, there have been problems such as insufficient support for SMEs, extremely uneven development in various regions, and low overall industrial levels. Therefore, it is particularly important to conduct long-term and in-depth investigation and analysis of the development of small and medium-sized enterprises in different regions of our country. Based on big data, this paper analyzes and researches the characteristics of small and micro-enterprises' electric power user load and business climate index. First, it uses literature research methods to describe the characteristics of electricity consumption in different industries, and then introduces the business climate index. After collecting relevant data, the data is sorted and analyzed. In this article, we mainly summarize the prosperity index of small, medium and micro enterprises in Beijing and Tianjin.

articleTitle: Application of Data Augmentation of Rare Words Based on “Font-CycleGan” in Character Recognition
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Given the low efficiency of massive image data processing in actual business departments, image character recognition OCR (optical character recognition) based on deep learning neural networks is not high. Based on the above background, a text image data enhancement method based on Font-CycleGan is proposed to improve text recognition accuracy. Our goal is to generate the data of specific fonts for the original hidden word text samples through the font library and then enhance the data of the hidden word text through CycleGan to enrich the database of the hidden word text to improve the performance of the classifier and the accuracy of text recognition. We evaluate and compare the impact of traditional character recognition and font-cyclgan based data to enhance character recognition accuracy. The results show that the improvement effect of this method is more significant.

articleTitle: Based on genetic algorithm to analyze the advantages and disadvantages of parking lot
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Building a parking decision model with effective and complete information and mastering the relationship between the factors influencing parking decision and parking decision behavior can provide more scientific guidance for drivers. After determining the main influencing factors of parking decision, including walking distance, parking cost, travel time and parking convenience, the parking decision model is adopted with integrated genetic algorithm and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method. Finally, the relationship between driver's parking decision behavior and influencing factors is analyzed.

articleTitle: Application Research of Spark in Corporate Online Data Monitoring and Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Power grid companies produce and collect massive amounts of data in production and operation, operation management, marketing management, etc. Using data analysis to reflect the status of power grid company operation, mining the deep value of data, and boosting decision analysis for corporate management, are the key for digital transformation. Spark, which has both advanced architecture and high computational efficiency, is used to build an online data monitoring and analysis platform for enterprises. Such platform is aiming to improve the cross-discipline and cross-module data processing and data mining capabilities for power grid companies. Thus, all-service and all-scenario data acquisition is achieved; and its analysis models can be applied and reused. Lastly, it uses results from high-speed, high-quality data analysis to promote business development enabled by the application of corporate data.

articleTitle: Research on the Failure Mechanism of Components in a Complex Mechanical System Via Quantitative Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: The problem of mechanical system failure has been widely studied. However, researchers did not quantify these issues from a macro perspective. This paper discusses the theory of conversion between components in machine system. A new analysis method of system fault mechanism of plasma propagation is proposed, which divides the mechanical system into three groups, non-fault components, fault components and maintenance components. Then, the state equation describing its dynamic behavior in complex mechanical systems is derived and the steady-state analysis is carried out. New influence rate, maintenance rate, exclusion rate and repair rate are introduced, and the influence of four parameters on the fault is studied. The simulation results are in good agreement with the theoretical analysis. Suggestions on how to control system failure are put forward. These experiments described a little of fascinating failure extension modes in repairable systems.

articleTitle: Research on the Extensive Model of Information Systems under Big Data and Computer Aided Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: This article discusses the integrated construction of the information management system for the grassroots track and field games from two levels: the general mode of main functions and the logical construction of system R&D design ideas. Combined with the actual situation of school physical education, a set of college track and field sports information management system was designed with VisualFoxPro, ASP, and VBScript. It mainly includes online registration, data compilation and report printing modules. The application of our college's track and field games shows that this computerized arrangement system can effectively reduce labor intensity, improve data accuracy, and can output various real-time data and reports in a timely manner. The operation is simple, flexible, and the interface is friendly. It is a college track and field game.

Author Keywords: college track and field teaching system
track and field sports meeting management system

articleTitle: Research and Application of Intelligent Question-Answer Algorithm Based on Multi-Channel Dilated Convolution
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Electricity is the most important energy driving force for people's production and life. Power customer service is the external service communication window of power enterprises. With the rapid development of Deep Learning and Artificial Intelligence in recent years, it has become the future development trend to use online Question Answer system to solve user's problems in real time. The knowledge base of power customer service is sorted out through the historical dialogue data of State Grid manual customer service in the past. The problem that is most similar to the new problem in the knowledge base is obtained by using the “Question-Question” matching pattern, and the corresponding answer of the problem is output. To solve the problem that existing text matching models are difficult to obtain multi-scale semantic information, a text matching model based on multi-channel dilated convolution is proposed in this paper. It can capture text features at multiple scales so as to compare sentence similarity according to richer semantic features. Experiments show that the model has excellent performance.

articleTitle: Multi-objective particle swarm optimization for selecting optimal grid learning without replacement sampling
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: A novel multi-objective particle swarm optimization is proposed in this paper, which can select the optimal grid learning without replacement sampling (WRSMOPSO). The algorithm first adaptively groups the population according to the optimal number of grids, then selects the optimal grid for each group without replacement sampling, and finally selects the optimal solution randomly from the selected optimal grids for learning. In order to ensure the diversity and convergence of the algorithm, this paper also established a new external archive control strategy based on grid technology. The WRSMOPSO and the classic MOPSO are simulated experiments on the benchmark function. Experimental results show that the WRSMOPSO can effectively improve the inverted generational distance (IGD) and hypervolume indicator (HV), which compares with classic MOPSO, the WRSMOPSO shows good overall performance.

articleTitle: Anti-Interference Methodologies Used for Transformer Noise Test Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the noise signal detection of transformer is easily interfered by the external environment, three anti-interference test methods are proposed based on the time-frequency characteristics of the typical insects, birds, frogs and vehicle noise around the transformer, including wavelet packet spectral subtraction, short-time window method and filter method. The effectiveness of the algorithm is verified by field measurement. The results show that both wavelet packet spectral subtraction method and filter method can achieve better suppression effect for different interference sources, and their performance is generally better than that of short-time window method. The result has important reference significance for improving the measurement accuracy of transformer noise in complex environment.

articleTitle: Application of Industrial Robots in Grinding Technology through Path Planning and Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: As a more important operation process in the field of industrial parts processing, the grinding quality and efficiency of grinding technology directly affects the production efficiency of the whole parts processing. This study focuses on the overall analysis of the application of industrial robots in grinding technology at the present stage through three different research perspectives, such as, The design of industrial robot grinding end-effector structure, industrial robot grinding path planning, and the force control of industrial robot grinding, and proposes the future development trend.

articleTitle: An adaptive knowledge distillation algorithm for text classification
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Using knowledge distillation to compress pre-trained models such as Bert has proven to be highly effective in text classification tasks. However, the overhead of tuning parameters manually still hinders their application in practice. To alleviate the cost of manual tuning of parameters in training tasks, inspired by the inverse decrease of the word frequency of TF-IDF, this paper proposes an adaptive knowledge distillation method (AKD). This core idea of the method is based on the Cosine similarity score which is calculated by the probabilistic outputs similarity measurement in two networks. The higher the score, the closer the student model's understanding of knowledge is to the teacher model, and the lower the degree of imitation of the teacher model. On the contrary, we need to increase the degree to which the student model imitates the teacher model. Interestingly, this method can improve distillation model quality. Experimental results show that the proposed method significantly improves the precision, recall and F1 value of text classification tasks. However, training speed of AKD is slightly slower than baseline models. This study provides new insights into knowledge distillation.

articleTitle: Online substation equipment recognition technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Fast and reliable identification on transformer substation devices is the prerequisite for AR system to perform virtual information display and virtual-real fusion. Hence the author proposes to establish a transformer substation equipment recognition model relying on deep-learning technology, and deploy it on edge devices such as AR, etc. Firstly, collect the images and videos of transformer substation devices, obtain the dataset of transformer substation devices, and use the mark labeling software to build the dataset. Secondly, apply the Faster RCNN object identification algorithm to establish the transformer substation devices identification model on the basis of VGG16 convolutional network. Then, improve the precision of the model through data migration model training, parameter optimization, and dataset enhancement methods such as image transformation. Finally, deploy the algorithm to Intel Neural Compute Stick 2, realizing the online identification of major devices in transformer substation such as the main transformer, breaker, voltage transformer, current transformer and control cabinet, and providing basis for the application of AR system on the training, practical inspection, and operation and maintenance.

articleTitle: A Multi-modal Attention-based Seq2eq Model for Predicting Real-estate Prices
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Some studies show that the closure and reopening orders brought by covid-19 have had a negative impact on the residential real estate market. Generally speaking, real estate sales decreased significantly during this period, such as office buildings, shopping centers and family houses. Although the overall situation is declining, there are also some new situations. For example, people's desire for spacious family space caused by home office leads to an increase in the demand for large houses in the suburbs. This paper mainly compares the sales differences between suburban family houses and urban family houses in San Francisco and New York in the real estate market during covid-19. The data come from multiple dimensions such as house listing price on the real estate sales website, Machine learning methods could be used for analysis. This paper proposed a multi-modal joint attention seq2seq method to analyze these differences and the reasons for the differences. The experimental results show that one of the possible reasons the house price change in San Francisco is that there are more high-tech job position and their family income is higher than the average level of other regions.

articleTitle: DetachMix: Color Channels Fusion for Training Object Detection Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Pre-training strategies greatly improve various image classification model's accuracy. They have proved to be effective for guiding the model to attend on objects in complex samples, thereby letting the network perform better without adding extra inference cost. However, the training strategies and pipelines dramatically vary among different models, and they only change the complexity of the samples, but do not really combine the targets with the training process of the network. We therefore propose the DetachMix augmentation strategy, and it is divided into two steps: the first step is to segment the picture according to the color channels and train them separately on the network.The second step is to merge the first convolutional layer of the obtained weight files to replace the one obtained during normal training. The network model gained through DetachMix can not only combine images with network training, but also can be used in combination with other methods of processing samples (such as cutmix [1], Mixup [2], etc.). The method we proposed improves network performance by improving the network's ability to extract original semantic information from picture, and it is applicable to all models with the same reasoning time. We conducted a test on the collected Person Head State dataset and compared our method with the latest data processing methods. DetachMix can improve up to at most 8.3% precision compared to state-of-the-art baselines,reached 91.43 %.

articleTitle: Study and Design an Equipment-fault-diagnosis System Based on 3D Draft Software
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: This paper investigate a newly fault diagnosis system and trainee system based on 3D draft software. Compared to traditional fault diagnosis system, a system established on 3D software enables user easily to control manipulating system and aware of rate of process. In this paper, it firstly lists advantage and disadvantage of traditional fault diagnosis system, secondly introduces 3D draft software and practical application, lastly discusses benefit when combines 3D draft in fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Design of Palm Vein Platform and Pattern Enhancement Model Based on Raspberry Pi
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of biometrics technology, vein recognition is slowly integrating into our lives. At present, there are many related applications of hand veins and finger veins. The palm veins are deep under the skin and interfere with palm prints, which increases the difficulty of obtaining them, resulting in relatively few applications. Based on the research of palm vein image acquisition, this paper designs a set of auxiliary acquisition equipment to complete the acquisition of vein images under a comfortable somatosensory. The device takes the Raspberry Pi as the core of the model, supplemented by accessories such as luminous light source, optical sensor, control chip and small display, which can complete the collection of vein images. And through the algorithm of restricted contrast histogram equalization, Gaussian denoising, gabor filtering and other algorithms optimized for palm veins in the Raspberry Pi, the palm vein lines are enhanced to improve the image quality. The model integrates multiple modules into one mold, greatly reduces the volume of the model, improves the speed of the overall collection process, and has good application value.

articleTitle: Dragonfly Optimization-based MPPT Algorithm for Standalone PV System under Partial Shading
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Currently, Photovoltaic (PV) technology has higher demand in the market and gaining momentum day by day. However, partial shading is the most significant concern as it reduces the efficiency of standalone PV systems. Partially shading is typically induced by non-uniform sunlight and uncertain temperature fluctuations. The maximum power point tracking (MPPT) algorithms play a major role in determining the overall system's efficiency. The PV system creates several peaks in its power voltage (P-V) characteristic curve under partial shadowing. To make the PV system run under partial shading at global maximum power point (GMPP), the dragonfly optimization (DFO) algorithm is put forward in this research article. The proposed DFO technique and other commonly used MPPT techniques, such as Particle swarm optimization (PSO), Perturb and Observe (P&O), is investigated through theoretical analysis and simulation using Matlab/Simulink to authenticate the overall performance of the DFO approach under partial shading. Furthermore, the comparison demonstrates that the suggested DFO strategy provides very high reliability, efficiency, robustness, rapid power tracking and lower response time to trace the GMPP than PSO and P&O techniques. Hence, the DFO technique's overall performance under partial shading is appropriate and satisfying.

articleTitle: Research on Fall Detection Algorithm for the Elderly Living Alone Based on YOLO
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: The 21st century is an era of rapid population aging, and accidental falls have gradually become the number one killer threatening the health of the elderly. Nowadays, the rapid development of computer vision provides a new solution for elderly fall detection. However, traditional machine learning methods have disadvantages such as cumbersome detection steps, poor real-time performance, bloated model deployment, and poor robustness in complex scenarios. This paper uses the YOLO series of algorithms to automatically extract features, and complete the end-to-end prediction of the target frame and category at one time. In this paper, two modified YOLOV4 and YOLOV5S networks are used as fall detection models. The network is classified and trained on a self-made fall data set, and tested in real scenarios to compare the performance indicators of the two models. Experiments show that the use of YOLOV5S can basically achieve real-time and accurate end-to-end detection and the model is lightweight and easy to deploy, and has good robustness in complex environments.

articleTitle: A new energy trading model for virtual power plants based on blockchain
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: As a distributed system with decentralization, trust maintenance, and security assurance, blockchain has successfully served a variety of scenarios involving information exchange and ledger recording. In the blockchain system, the characteristics of peer and autonomy of each node, coupled with the traceability of the blockchain system, the nature of information disclosure and the nature of distributed information storage, make it ubiquitous in the modern Internet of Power Energy It has unique advantages such as safety and efficiency in application scenarios such as the Internet of Power and Energy. First introduced the core application principles of blockchain technology and analyzed the application feasibility of blockchain technology based on the Ethereum network in the virtual power plant (Virtual Power Plant VPP) energy transaction; then on the basis of the Ethereum blockchain platform In the above, a power energy transaction scheme under the virtual power plant architecture is proposed; then the test is carried out in the standard Ethereum test network and virtual environment to verify the feasibility, safety and scalability of the method; finally, the block Analyze and prospect the opportunities and challenges of chain technology in the field of combining virtual power plants and “Internet +”.

articleTitle: Electric Vehicle Configuration Recommendation Algorithm Using Clustering Fusion Matrix Decomposition and Pearson Calculation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: This article combines users' attitudes towards life, car values, and users' ratings of new energy configurations to build a new energy vehicle configuration recommendation model. First, determine the data source, and process the data for outliers and missing values, use the Pearson correlation coefficient to calculate the correlation coefficient matrix between users. The coefficient matrix is combined with density clustering to cluster the users; secondly, the comprehensive similarity between the new energy vehicle configurations is calculated, and the density clustering is also used to cluster the configurations; Then, construct a mapping table for users to score configurations based on the clustering results between users and configurations; finally, use matrix factorization technology to make predictions, and give recommended configurations based on the prediction results.

articleTitle: Data Sets Modeling and Frequency Prediction via Machine Learning and Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: In recent years, generalized linear models have been widely used in auto insurance pricing, and some research results show that machine learning is better than generalized linear models in some aspects, but these results are only based on a single data set. In order to more comprehensively compare the effects of generalized linear models and machine learning methods on the problem of car insurance claim frequency prediction, a comparative test was carried out on 7 car insurance data sets, including deep learning, random forest, support vector machine, XGboost and other machine learning methods; Based on the same training set, establish different generalized linear models to predict the frequency of claims, select the best generalized linear model according to the minimum information criterion (AIC); obtain the best machine learning parameters and models through cross-validation tuning. The research results show that the prediction effect of XGboost on all data sets is consistently better than the generalized linear model; for some data sets with more independent variables and strong correlation between variables, the prediction effects of neural networks, deep learning and random forests Better than generalized linear models.

articleTitle: Computer Intelligent Prediction Method for Hot Event by Long Short-Term Memory Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: At present, with the development of the Internet, people can timely post their cognitions, attitudes and emotions about hot events, which constitute the network public opinions. Through the analysis of the network public opinions and sentiments, the evolution of hot events can be judged and further provided suggestion to relevant departments to deal with hot event crisis. The exiting approaches still have some shortages, such as inaccurate classification of sentimants and topics, poor predicting capability of traditional prediction models. To sovle those problems, we propose a novel approach, which is based on sentiment analysis, text clustering and LSTM neural network model. First, we extracted emotional tendencies to classify text comments into positive and negative stentiments with SnowNLP, a Chinese natural language processing tool. Second, based on the Single-Pass clustering algorithm, we implemented text cluster analysis to explore hot topics. At last, we predicted the public emtional trends and the topic attention trends with a Long-Short-Term Memory model(LSTM). The experiments show that our approach has a high accuracy of prediction about the evolution trend of hot events.

articleTitle: Robust Partitioning Scheme for Accelerating SQL Database
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: SQL Databases have shown tremendous performance in the last four decades. Data consistency, isolation, and durability are the main strengths of SQL databases. However, in relational databases, computing joins are time-consuming at run time. To address this issue, we propose to utilize the Oracle partitioning technique to enhance specific query performance. Physical database tuning approaches of SQL databases are being used to speed up each SQL statement such as partitioning and indexing. With the partitioning technique, the Oracle 11g RDBMS efficiency performance improves by approximately absolute 50%. Additionally, we compare its performance with the state-of-the-art NoSQL graph database (Neo4j).

articleTitle: Research on Named Entity Recognition Based on ELECTRA and Intelligent Face Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the corpus of drug-related fields is not rich and the relevant information of drug-related personnel is insufficient, this paper constructs a 600,000-word-scale drug-related text data set, and proposes a named entity recognition method for drug-related personnel based on ELECTRA-BiLSTM-CRF. First input the labeled text into the ELECTRA pre-training language model to obtain a word vector with better semantic representation; then input the trained word vector into the bidirectional long short-term memory (BiLSTM) network to extract the context feature; finally, the best predicted label sequence is obtained through the conditional random field(CRF). The performance of this model was evaluated on the drug-related text data set. The experimental results showed that the F1 value of the ELECTRA-BiLSTM-CRF model reached 94%, which was better than the BERT-BiLSTM-CRF, BERT-CRF, and BiLSTM-CRF models, which proved this model has a good effect on the named entity recognition of drug-related personnel.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Intelligent Risk Prediction Model and Identification Algorithm with Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: With the rapid development of economics, consumer lending and trust loan have gained unprecedented growth all over the world. Due to the serious consequence of borrowers' breach of contract, banks need a valid method to help managing credit risk. Till now, the most common way is to set up blacklist and whitelist according to previous loan records to assist bank in deciding whether to offer loan to someone or not. In other words, there is a fixed threshold to filter customers. Once borrower has a number of violations beyond the threshold, the bank will add him into the blacklist which means the man cannot get debt in the future according to his poor credit. This simple method may be useful but it also has some inevitable downsides resulting from its empirical nature. For instance, this approach still needs to be conducted with countless bank workers, accounting for its failure in satisfying soaring need in current changeable loan scenario. Meanwhile, the manually set threshold is not sensitive to massive data, which is more than unavoidable in today's life. To the best of our knowledge, machine learning methods are suitable to deal with huge amount of data and make accurate predictions. Considering the characteristics in consumer lending and trust loan, we put forward a new algorithm model implemented with machine learning knowledge to determine whether or not a loan should be granted. The method contains some cutting-edge machine learning ideas such as tree model and neural network. This new credit scoring framework can solve above problems effectively and control the expenditure within an acceptable range. In the experiments, we evaluate our method extensively on bank credit dataset, and the results demonstrate that it outperforms most credit scoring and risk prediction methods, achieving an AUC of 0.840 on the Test Set.

articleTitle: Improve the Application of XGBDT in Network Abnormal Traffic Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Detecting abnormal traffic in real life often requires analyzing massive data (high-dimensional data) and unbalanced data. Aiming at the above problems, an intrusion detection model (SMBR-XGBDT) based on the combination of SMOTE algorithm and Boruta algorithm with Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) algorithm is proposed. The experiment selected 14367 extremely unbalanced samples based on the CIRA-CIC-DoHBrw-2020 data set, and detected 4 categories: DOH, Non-DoH, Benign-DoH, Malicious-DoH, using decision tree algorithm, random forest Algorithm, XGBoost algorithm as a control. The experimental results show that the SMBR-XGBDT model is significantly better than the other three models. The precision, recall, and F1 scores of the overall test were 93%, 93 %, and 93 %, respectively, which verified the effectiveness of the method. The precision rates of DOH, Non-DoH, Benign-DoH, Malicious-DoH were 88%, 100%, 98%, and 87%, respectively, which verified the feasibility of the method to deal with unbalanced data.

articleTitle: A Intelligent Prediction Model Using Bayesian Discrimination and Computer Simulation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Predicting the purchase intention of customers is very important to the relevant decision-making departments of brands. This article aims to provide decision-making basis and suggestions for decision-making departments by analyzing the personal situation and related satisfaction of electric vehicle target customers. This article first classifies users based on systematic clustering, uses Spearman correlation coefficients, etc. to find factors that are strongly related to customers' purchase intentions. Secondly, this article uses logistic regression analysis and establishes a Bayesian discriminant model to predict the correctness of purchases. The results were compared, and the most accurate model was adopted to understand the customer's purchase intention; finally, the objective function was established and solved when the satisfaction degree was increased by 5%, This paper provides suggestions for car companies in terms of market positioning and service intensity.

articleTitle: Big Data Analysis on Online Platform Model Based on 5G Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: This The 5G era brings unprecedented opportunities and challenges to the online community marketing. This paper starts from the definition of the online community marketing, and thinking about the influence of 5G on the online community marketing. Based on the features of 5G, we try to build the model of the online community marketing in the 5G digital economic era. We explain the model from five aspects, data based, technology driven, seize the mind with precision, immersive experience, capture the audience in an all-round way in order to help enterprises to build a healthy online community marketing business ecological closed loop.

articleTitle: Exploration of Cloud Computing and Deep Learning on Smart Building Management Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: As an important pillar of China's national economy, the construction industry promotes the development of China's economy. Due to the late start of China's construction industry and the corresponding construction technology is not advanced enough to make China's construction industry intelligent level is low, for the above problems, this paper proposes a cloud computing and deep learning based intelligent building integrated management platform architecture, the hierarchy is mainly divided into the perception layer, network layer and application layer, the perception layer has intelligent sensors and intelligent controller and other basic components, responsible for the collection of building construction The perception layer is composed of basic components such as smart sensors and smart controllers, which are responsible for collecting data during the construction process, combining cloud computing technology and neural network as the network layer to analyze and process the massive data in the construction project, and finally feeding the data information to the application layer, so that the construction party and supervision department can visualize the progress of the construction project at any time, and also detect the construction condition in real time, thus improving the building intelligence level.

articleTitle: Research on Emergency Methods for Terminal Risk Areas of Power System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Due to the high degree of node correlation in the risk area, once the risk breaks out, it will be costly to restrain and block the risk. Therefore, considering limited resources, an emergency method in risky areas with maximum returns is proposed. First, according to the state of the risk area of the system, an emergency measure is proposed that combines the adjustment of the injection power of the node and the cut-off of the node due to overload to avoid the aggregation of high load nodes in an area. local. Then, comprehensively consider the effect and cost of emergency measures, design economic and safety assessment indicators, and create an emergency model for the terminal risk area of the electrical system. Finally, the differential evolution algorithm is used to solve the emergency model, which can achieve the best economic efficiency while effectively suppressing risks.

articleTitle: Short-term urban traffic prediction based on deep learning: A systematic map
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Short-term urban traffic prediction is of great importance to improve travel and material transportation efficiency. It provides the basis of navigation planning, traffic configuration, and traffic management. The early traffic prediction methods are mainly based on machine learning methods. Due to the popularization of big data technology and the Internet of Things technology, the current traffic prediction method mainly leverages deep learning methods. However, deep learning methods have many choices for short-term traffic city prediction. There is no research to show which deep learning method is suitable for short-term urban traffic prediction. We conducted a systematic map study on 29 papers selected in the short-term urban traffic prediction in the past five years. And analyzed which deep learning methods can be applied to short-term urban traffic forecasting, and find out which methods are more suitable for traffic forecasting, and finally discuss the development trend of traffic prediction methods.

articleTitle: Optimization of a Four-Factor Model for China Using Machine Learning Algorithm and Intelligent Computational Method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Due to the special characteristics of the Chinese A-share market, the traditional three-factor model for US stocks cannot be well applied to the Chinese market. We adopt the China-appropriate four-factor model proposed by Liu, Zhou and Zhu (2019) to systematically apply machine learning to enhance the stock return prediction module in fundamental quantitative investment. The empirical results show that LZZ's four-factor model is indeed better than the FF-3 model. At the same time, the machine learning algorithm is able to effectively identify complex patterns between factor-excess returns complex patterns, and its investment strategy can achieve better investment performance than traditional linear algorithms.

articleTitle: Photo Steel Stamp Removal Algorithm Based on Image Filtering
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: In modern society, it is necessary to use the photo with steel stamp on the ID for matching to search and match specific pedestrians. The steel stamp on the ID photo will obscure most of the portrait information, so it is essential to eliminate the stamp to get a clearer portrait. In this paper, an integrated filtering algorithm is proposed to eliminate the photo stencil area by marking the location of the stencil on the photo, followed by combining three different types of filtering algorithms. Three filtering algorithms can be chosen for the calculation of the steel stamp points as well as the points in the steel stamp field. The first filtering algorithm is a method which improves the principle of mean filtering, and it replaces the original value by calculating the mean of the steel mark point and its field range. The second filtering algorithm is an improvement on the principle of median filtering by calculating the median value of the stencil as well as its domain range, and then replacing the median value with the value of the stencil pixel point as well as the domain range. The third filtering algorithm is based on the principle of Gaussian filtering. The weight values of the steel mark and its field range are calculated by Gaussian template, so as to replace the value of the steel mark pixel point and its neighborhoods. By combining the Mean, Median and Gaussian filters into one new filter, the integrated filtering algorithm does not require the Creation of a mask. Meanwhile, it has been verified effective in eliminating photo stencil areas than the single filter and other types of traditional elimination algorithms available in the image processing.

articleTitle: Research and Application Demonstration of Predictive Maintenance Cloud Platform for Building Intelligent Perception Equipment
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: At present, Chongqing is vigorously promoting the construction of a new smart city, and continuously promulgating new documents to promote the orderly construction of the Internet of Things in urban infrastructure, and provide key basic data support for the Chongqing City Information Modeling (CIM platform). After years of development, the city's urban infrastructure has achieved good results in terms of quantity and quality. However, for the important sensing equipment (elevators, security, temperature and humidity sensors, biogas concentration, etc.) that are related to the society and people's livelihood in the building, and There is no unified collection and monitoring, but to promote the smart construction of the community, the collection and utilization of public equipment data are important evaluation indicators. We will not only establish a Chongqing smart community management platform, but also display the statistical information of important equipment data online, The real-time status of equipment, historical data recording, utilization of equipment data and other functions must also be actively improved, so as to vigorously support the development and use of the CIM platform.

articleTitle: A Multi-time Scale Tie-line Energy and Reserve Allocation Model Considering Wind Power Uncertainty for Multi-area System in Hierarchical Control Structure
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Increasing proportion of centralized wind power integrated into partial areas of China leads to requirement in sharing both energy and reserve among areas under its inherent hierarchical control structure, and the unbalance power introduced by wind power uncertainty lead to requirement of correction from day ahead to intra-day along with the improvement of wind power prediction precision. In order to address these problems, this paper develops an information integration method integrating complicated relations among fuel cost, total thermal power output, reserve capacity, owned reserve and expectations of loading shedding and wind curtailment within this area into three types of time-related relation curves in different time scale. Furthermore, a multi-time scale tie-line energy and reserve allocation model is proposed, which contains two levels in control structure, two time scales in dispatch sequence and multiple areas integrated with wind farms. The efficiency of the proposed method is tested in 9-bus test system and IEEE 118-bus system. The results show that cross-regional control centre is able to allocate both energy and reserve among areas efficiently with the integrated relation curves. The proposed model not only relieves energy and reserve shortage in partial areas but also allocates them to more urgent areas in a high effectivity manner in both day-ahead and intraday time scale.

articleTitle: Application of Multidimensional Feature Visualization in Emergency Management of Venues
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: In the background of “Internet+”, the use of advanced information technology and Internet of Things technology to create brand-new “smart venues” has become the main trend now. However, due to the large number of people, complex personnel types and frequent emergencies, it is a challenging task to manage the venue intelligently. This paper introduces a multidimensional feature fusion trajectory clustering algorithm, and designs a visual analysis system. The system can monitor the movement track of the venue personnel in real time, analyze the type of personnel, dig the movement rule of personnel, find abnormal situations in time, prevent and deal with emergencies, and well meet the demand of “smart venue”. By contrast with the existing trajectory clustering methods, the clustering algorithm logic more closely, clustering richer, more realistic value, provides strong technical support for emergency management of venues.

articleTitle: Key-Region and Layout Learning for Contract Intelligent Identification
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Multimodality has become the main means of multimedia information analysis and understanding. Researchers at home and abroad have achieved good results in the field of multimodal learning. In this study, we introduce a new multimodal data representation to deal with the unstructured visual rich document understanding task. By introducing the key area features detected by the target, combining the two dimensional position information, we splice it into text embedding and image embedding, and input it into the transformer. This method not only retains the layout information of the document, the alignment learning between image and text is enhanced. The experimental results show that our model has a good effect on the public datasets FUNSD and DocVQA.

articleTitle: Span-based Model for Chinese Event Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Current Chinese Event Detection (ED) models often incorporate character-level features to improve model performance. In this paper, to incorporate span-level features, we propose a span-based Chinese event detection model (BiLSTM-span, Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory-span) and its extension (BiLSTM-span-ext). The BiLSTM-span model regards Chinese ED as a span classification problem rather than the sequence labeling problem, and the BiLSTM-span-ext, based on the BiLSTM-span, adds a component that could incorporate span-level information. The experimental results show that our model could achieve the F1 score, which is approximate to the current state-of-the-art Chinese ED model. Besides, we conduct extensive experiments to study span representation methods and show that span representation methods influence the BiLSTM-span model's performance dramatically. Last, we show that BiLSTM-span-ext's ability to incorporate dictionary information at the span-level.

articleTitle: Enhanced Magneto-optic Imaging Based on LSTM-CNN Model and Multi-modal Fusion
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Emergency Science and Information Technology (ICESIT)
abstract: Magneto-optic imaging technology is an optical means to detect metal defects. This category of technology will become particularly important in the widely developed precision industry. In this study, an alternating magnetic field is used to form a leakage magnetic field through a metal plate with defects. The leakage magnetic field passes through the Faraday effect magneto-optic device to generate polarization in the optical path. When the linearly polarized light passing through the device, the image with various manipulated metal plate defect characteristics can be displayed in the CCD. By using AC magnetic field could add time-dependence of the training data based on the CCD images. Based on LSTM-CNN model and multi-modal fusion technique, a precise prediction on the defects of metal could be made.
